name: Cora
description:
Connect Cora and bring your entire customer operation into Claude. Cora's Account Brain holds persistent memory across your CRM, support tickets, product usage, calls, and Slack, so every query is grounded in the whole customer relationship rather than one system's view of it.

Ask which accounts are at risk this quarter and what to do about them. Generate QBR summaries, prep docs, account briefs, and dashboards from live data. Update your CRM, send email and Slack, and assign tasks.

Then automate it. Build and schedule Cora agents that watch for signals and run the work themselves.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cora.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cora MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cora provides these MCP tools: activate_skill, call_tool, list_custom_skills, load_custom_skill, search_tools, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cora?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cora in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Cora requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cora is developed by Cora AI, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
